transfers.consistency_rule: Q3 must use the identical solver instance and parameter set as Q2. The Q3 field evaluated at t=10800 s must equal the Q2 field at t=10800 s to within 1e-12 relative difference.
transfers.violation_meaning: any discrepancy indicates configuration drift between the two runs, not physics

transfers.consistency_rule: Q3 extends the same fields in time; it introduces the terminal criterion only. No governing equation, property law, boundary condition or discretisation may change.
new_in_Q3: linear interpolation of the crossing instant
output granularity 60 s instead of 1 s

observed.source: modeling-stage numerical prototype, N=21, dt=1 s, Kirchhoff face diffusivity
observed.authoritative_source: comp-code stage output; if comp-code deviates by more than 2 percent, follow anomaly plan A5
observed.bound_reason: latent heat of vaporisation is neglected, so T is overestimated, D is overestimated, and t_star is therefore a lower bound of the true drying time

shared_assumptions.note: inactive for Q2 because its 3 h span lies inside the 14400 s data window

unit_ledger.temperature_in_properties: absolute temperature K, i.e. T_K = T_degC + 273.15, mandated verbatim by appendix 3
unit_ledger.moisture_concentration: kg/kg dry basis, identical unit for herb and kiln air
